sentences.opening: Hello, I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank. We are recording this call. Am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?
sentences.robot: I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.
sentences.scam: You can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number.
sentences.pre_id_about: I can tell you more once I have confirmed I am speaking with the right person.
sentences.deceased: I am sorry for your loss.
sentences.dob_q: For your security, could you please tell me your date of birth?
sentences.phone_q: Thank you. Now, could you tell me the last four digits of the phone number we have on file?
sentences.swapped: Could you please say the month of your date of birth as a word?
sentences.wrong: That does not match our records.
sentences.failed: I am sorry, I could not verify your identity. Please use the Freya Bank mobile app or visit a branch.
sentences.tech: There was a technical problem. I will try once more.
sentences.today_q1: Can you make this payment today?
sentences.today_qn: Can you make these payments today?
sentences.paid: Thank you. Payments can take one business day to appear.
sentences.dispute: I understand, I will not ask you about that product.
sentences.sympathy: I am sorry to hear that.
sentences.support_offer: Would you like me to connect you with our customer support team?
sentences.human_first: Before I connect you, can I help you with this myself?
sentences.discount: I am sorry, I cannot offer a discount, a waiver or any other terms.
sentences.no_info: I am sorry, I do not have that information.
sentences.change_app: A recorded promise cannot be changed in this call, but you can change it in the Freya Bank mobile app.
sentences.sms: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
sentences.bye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.

unclear.what: service error outcome for verify/get_account/callback/transfer failures
unclear.choice: no_promise/service_error (only reason the brief gives for tool failure)
amounts said as numbers without currency
